shell.backgroundTitle: Media Studio is running in the background

download.name: Video downloader
download.description: Download video and audio from YouTube, X and more.

instagram.name: Instagram Download
instagram.description: Save photos and videos from Instagram posts, carousels, stories and whole profiles.

video_sync.name: Audio-Video Sync
video_sync.description: Align out-of-sync audio tracks with video, preview with waveforms and export.

video_to_gif.name: Video to GIF
video_to_gif.description: Turn a clip of a video into an animated GIF, WebP or APNG.

gif_editor.name: GIF Editor
gif_editor.description: Optimize, resize, crop, speed up or reverse animated GIFs.

compressor.name: Image compressor
compressor.description: Reduce PNG, JPEG and WebP file sizes with live comparison and target-size matching.

image_tools.name: Image tools
image_tools.description: Resize, crop, rotate and mirror single images or entire folders.

converter.name: Image converter
converter.description: Convert whole folders of images between formats.

rembg.name: AI Background Remover
rembg.description: Remove backgrounds with sub-pixel edge matting and anti-halo debleeding.

upscale.name: AI Image Upscaler
upscale.description: Enlarge photos and graphics 2x or 4x with full transparency support.

watermark.name: Watermark remover
watermark.description: Paint over a watermark and remove it with OpenCV or AI.

tts.name: Text to speech
tts.description: Turn text into natural-sounding speech in many languages.

transcribe.name: Transcription
transcribe.description: Turn speech in videos and recordings into subtitles or text.

pdf.name: PDF Merger
pdf.description: Arrange pages from several PDFs and merge them into one.

pdf_compress.name: PDF Compressor
pdf_compress.description: Reduce PDF file size by optimizing embedded images and structure.

pdf_split.name: PDF Splitter
pdf_split.description: Split document into single pages or chosen groups of pages.

pdf_convert.name: PDF ↔ Images
pdf_convert.description: Convert PDF pages to image files or create a PDF from images.

pdf_extract.name: PDF Text Extractor
pdf_extract.description: Extract plain text from PDF document pages into a .txt file.

duplicates.name: Duplicate finder
duplicates.description: Find similar photos and videos, even after resizing.
